assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create the final game logo for "LOOTMON", an original colorful monster-themed treasure hunting adventure game. Exact text: "LOOTMON", correctly spelled, one word, all uppercase, highly legible at small sizes.
A professionally drawn playful game wordmark, broad chunky custom letters with a slight upward energetic arc, warm golden yellow faces (#ffdf42), creamy highlights, thick cobalt blue (#3a75bd) outline and deep navy (#294572) outer extrusion. A small lively coral-red (#ed5967) card-shaped loot badge with a four-point gleam can nest beside the beginning of the word; keep the word dominant. Distinctive original letterforms with clean contours and restrained polished cel-shaded depth. Friendly collectible-creature adventure mood. Bold polished Nintendo-era adventure identity without copying an existing logo.
Composition: one compact horizontal standalone logo, centered and almost filling a wide canvas with comfortable transparent margins; no separate mascot illustration, no subheading, no tagline, no additional text, no scene. Crisp smooth edges, silhouette readable on white and blue interfaces. Genuinely transparent background, no checkerboard baked into image, no background panel, no mockup, no sheet of variants.

assets.name: SCOUT
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Generate one standalone illustrated foil booster pack for the game LOOTMON, tier SCOUT. Image 1 is the official Lootmon logo REFERENCE: faithfully reproduce its exact readable LOOTMON lettering, yellow letters, blue outline and red card emblem as the large brand logo across the top of the pack.
A coherent high-quality playful collectible game product asset. ONE upright sealed rectangular foil packet, straight front view, no tilt and minimal perspective, crimped seal along top and bottom, softly rounded edges. Full packet uncropped. Pack width approximately 58% of pack height. Center it nearly filling a tall canvas with small transparent margins.
Packaging layout: bold navy-blue outer line and frame, blue top band featuring the reference LOOTMON logo large and very readable; small coral-red corner accents; a vivid fresh leaf green and mint, with pale warm cream light body showing a charming small mint-green forest fox creature with oversized leaf-shaped ears, amber eyes, cream belly and a curled fern tail; original monster design. The monster is a large clear cel-shaded cartoon hero with thick clean dark-blue linework occupying the center of the packet, surrounded by just a few broad leaf/wave/spark motifs appropriate to its element. A cream-white bottom ribbon outlined in deep blue clearly reads "SCOUT" in bold uppercase letters. One small gold four-point gleam emblem beneath the creature.
Style: polished charming adventure videogame packaging illustration, bold simple shapes, clean confident contour lines, rich flat colors with gentle highlights and restrained foil gleams. Match existing UI palette cobalt #3a75bd, deep navy #294572, yellow #ffdf42, coral #ed5967 and creamy white. Original monster design. Crisp and readable at tiny UI size. No photorealistic creature, no ornate engraving or filigree, no distressed textures, no busy scenery, no extra logos, no tiny illegible text, no prices, no trading cards outside the pack, no hands, no drop shadow outside the pack. Only text is LOOTMON and SCOUT. Genuinely transparent background; do not render a checkerboard.
